caption:
📖 Every vocab blank leaves a clue. Find it first.

Stop guessing on vocab blanks.

✅ Restatement: a colon, a dash, "in other words"
✅ Contrast: although, yet, but, rather than.
✅ Cause or effect: because, so, as a result.
✅ "Although the plan seemed simple, carrying it out was ______."
✅ No clue yet? Read the sentence before and after the blank.

Save this for test day 🔖
